Explore this repository in readonly mode and identify existing noir/CRT/scanline/terminal visual effect implementations for AXEL. Focus on AXEL/axel_project/scenes/fx, shaders, overlays, autoload hooks, and any project settings or scripts that apply global visual filters. Return exact file paths and short explanation of current behavior and tuning knobs.
</user_query>

Searching the AXEL project for noir, CRT, scanline, and overlay effects.

[REDACTED]

Here is what exists in the repo today for noir / CRT-style / scanline / terminal visuals, with paths and tuning notes.

## Overworld: global noir (screen post-process)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\noir_palette_filter.gdshader` | `canvas_item` shader: samples `screen_texture` (`hint_screen_texture`), converts luminance to a **4-step palette** (`black` → `dark_blood` → `blood_red` → `white`). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` | **`CanvasLayer` `layer = 90`**, child `FilterRect` (`ColorRect`) full viewport, `mouse_filter` ignore, uses the shader material. |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\noir_overlay_guard.gd` | `@tool` script on the overlay root: **`visible = false` in the editor** so the screen-texture pass does not blank/flood the editor view. |

**Tuning knobs (shader uniforms):** `black_color`, `dark_blood_color`, `blood_red_color`, `white_color`, and luminance cutoffs `t0`, `t1`, `t2` (defaults in the shader file; override per-instance on the `ShaderMaterial` if needed).

**Where it is instanced:**  
- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.1_SchoolExterior.tscn`  
- `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.2_Corridor.tscn`

**Scene-level optional retune:**  
`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\Arc_1\1.2_Corridor.gd` holds `_USE_LOCAL_NOIR_TUNING` (currently `false`). When `true`, `_apply_local_noir_tuning()` sets `t2` and `white_color` on `NoirPaletteOverlay/FilterRect`’s `ShaderMaterial` at runtime.

---

## Overworld: locker-local palette (not screen capture)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\locker_palette_filter.gdshader` | Same **4-band palette idea** but uses **`TEXTURE`** (sprite), then adds **`detail_strength`** (tonal variation), **`darken_factor`**, optional **`glow_strength`** (luminance-gated add). |

**Wiring:** Only **`1.2_Corridor.tscn`** references it: sub-resource `ShaderMaterial_locker_local` with explicit `shader_parameter/*` overrides; `LockerBypassLayer` is **`CanvasLayer` `layer = 95`** (above noir `90`). All `LockerNNBypass` sprites share that material; highlighted locker uses pulse/aura in GDScript, not a separate shader in the current scene file.

**Tuning knobs:** same four colors + `t0`–`t2`, plus `darken_factor`, `detail_strength`, `glow_strength`.

---

## Overworld: highlighted-locker shader (on disk only)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\scenes\fx\highlighted_locker_palette_filter.gdshader` | Simpler **TEXTURE** palette map + **`darken_factor`** only (no `detail_strength` / `glow_strength`). |

No `.tscn` in the project currently references this shader (only changelog mentions); **`1.2` uses `locker_palette_filter` for bypass sprites** instead. Treat as an alternate/legacy locker shader unless you wire it again.

---

## Combat: CRT-ish scanlines + chroma flicker

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\shaders\scanline_overlay.gdshader` | Horizontal **scan stripes** (`fract(UV.y * line_density)`), **`line_color`**, **`chroma_strength`** (weak R/B sin/cos on `UV.y`). |
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` | Full-screen `ScanlineOverlay` `ColorRect` with `ShaderMaterial_scanline`; scene sets `shader_parameter/line_color`, `line_density`, `chroma_strength`, and **`ColorRect.color` alpha `0.18`** (overall blend via the rect). |

**Note:** **`combat_root.tscn` does not reference any `.gdshader`** in this tree; scanlines are only on the **`combat_test`** scene.

---

## Terminal look (typography/theme, not a global filter)

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\ui\terminal_theme.tres` | **`VT323`** `default_font`, red-tinted `Label` / `Button` / etc. colors — terminal **UI styling**, no full-screen shader. |

Referenced e.g. from `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn` and `combat_test.tscn`.

---

## Autoload / `project.godot` / engine-wide rendering

| Path | Finding |
|------|---------|
| `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\project.godot` | **Single autoload:** `ScriptReloadMarker` → **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\ScriptReloadMarker.gd`** — logs to a debug file; **no visual pipeline**. Rendering section only notes **D3D12 driver** + window size; **no global post-process or environment** entries for noir/CRT. |

**Conclusion:** There is **no project-wide autoload** applying filters. “Global” noir is **per-scene** via instanced `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn`. Scanlines are **combat test UI only**. Docs under `plans/` mention `Scanlines.tscn` and CSS-era effects; **`Scanlines.tscn` does not exist** under `axel_project` in this workspace.

---

**Executive summary:** AXEL implements **full-viewport noir quantization** via `noir_palette_filter.gdshader` + `NoirPaletteOverlay.tscn` (layer 90) on Arc 1 scenes; **1.2** adds **locker_sprite** palette shaders on layer **95**. **CRT scanlines** live only in **`combat/shaders/scanline_overlay.gdshader`** wired in **`combat_test.tscn`**. Terminal feel is **`terminal_theme.tres` + fonts**, not a global shader. **`project.godot` has no global visual-filter autoload** beyond unrelated `ScriptReloadMarker`.
